execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
billboard <- read_csv("data/billboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_pattern = "wk(\\d+)",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )

ggplot(
  billboard_long,
  aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(artist, track))
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(x = "Week", y = "Ranking")

billboard_long |>
  group_by(artist, track, date.entered) |>
  summarise(
    last_week = max(week),
    rank_in_week_20 = rank[week == 20][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(last_week == 20) |>
  summarise(
    songs = n(),
    ranked_below_50 = sum(rank_in_week_20 > 50)
  )
```

```{r}
billboard |>
  summarise(across(
    c(wk1, wk4, wk10, wk20, wk40, wk76),
    list(present = \(x) sum(!is.na(x)), missing = \(x) sum(is.na(x)))
  )) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("week", "status"),
    names_sep = "_",
    values_to = "count"
  ) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = count)
```

```{r}
song_summary <- billboard_long |>
  group_by(artist, track, date.entered) |>
  summarise(
    first_rank = rank[which.min(week)],
    best_rank = min(rank),
    first_week_at_best_rank = min(week[rank == min(rank)]),
    total_weeks = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fastest_to_number_one <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank == 1) |>
  slice_min(first_week_at_best_rank, with_ties = TRUE) |>
  mutate(notable = "Fastest to #1")

slowest_to_number_one <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank == 1) |>
  slice_max(first_week_at_best_rank, with_ties = TRUE) |>
  mutate(notable = "Slowest to #1")

longest_top_ten_run <- song_summary |>
  filter(best_rank <= 10) |>
  slice_max(total_weeks, with_ties = TRUE) |>
  mutate(notable = "Longest chart run among top-10 songs")

bind_rows(
  fastest_to_number_one,
  slowest_to_number_one,
  longest_top_ten_run
) |>
  select(notable, artist, track, first_rank, best_rank,
         first_week_at_best_rank, total_weeks) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
notable_songs <- bind_rows(
  fastest_to_number_one,
  slowest_to_number_one,
  longest_top_ten_run
) |>
  mutate(legend_name = paste(artist, track, sep = " - ")) |>
  select(artist, track, date.entered, legend_name)

top_ten_tracks <- billboard_long |>
  semi_join(filter(song_summary, best_rank <= 10),
            by = c("artist", "track", "date.entered")) |>
  left_join(notable_songs,
            by = c("artist", "track", "date.entered")) |>
  mutate(legend_name = replace_na(legend_name, "Other top-10 songs"))

ggplot(
  top_ten_tracks,
  aes(x = week, y = rank, group = interaction(artist, track, date.entered),
      color = legend_name)
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Other top-10 songs" = "gray75",
      setNames(c("#D55E00", "#0072B2", "#009E73"), notable_songs$legend_name)
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(x = "Week", y = "Ranking", color = "Song")
```
